item.title: 2026 Cave Expedition Calendar - ChatGPT
item.description:
Related: Interests

Here is a calendar-friendly roadmap for unique cave diving expeditions in 2026, organized by optimal travel season, logistics window, and exploration potential. It avoids the Americas and prioritizes limestone karst areas with limited or no prior diving.

Q1: January – March

Madagascar – Tsingy & Ankarana Karst

  • Season: End of wet season (Feb–March) = best chance for flooded systems
  • Focus: Recon flooded cave sections, resurgences, and seasonal sumps
  • Notes: Team should plan logistics in Antsiranana region, with local guides and permits

Vietnam – Phong Nha–Ke Bang

  • Season: Dry season begins (ideal river levels, Jan–April)
  • Focus: Dive active river caves, unexplored sumps beyond tourist-accessible caves
  • Notes: Coordinate with existing UK/Vietnamese caving teams for access

Q2: April – June

Sulawesi - Indonesia, Indonesia – Maros-Pangkep Karst

  • Season: Dry season starts (May–Sept), ideal for remote access
  • Focus: Tower karst blue holes, resurgence diving
  • Notes: Use Makassar as staging base; drone topography for site ID

Oman – Hajar Mountains

  • Season: Spring runoff in Wadis (March–May)
  • Focus: Dive ephemeral pools, springs and flooded wadis
  • Notes: Permits via local government and collaboration with Omani Cave Exploration Team

Q3: July – September

Papua New Guinea – Hindenburg Wall & Muller Plateau

  • Season: Dry season (July–Oct), best for transport access
  • Focus: First cave dives in highland karst, resurgence mapping
  • Notes: Requires air transport and village permission; base out of Mt Hagen

Albania/Kosovo – Dinaric Karst

  • Season: Peak summer (July–Sept)
  • Focus: Survey large river cave entrances and dive resurgences
  • Notes: Use connections with Balkan caving clubs; ideal for mobile, vehicle-based expedition

Ethiopia – Sof Omar Cave

  • Season: After heavy rains (Aug–Sept) to find flooded sections
  • Focus: Subterranean river diving
  • Notes: Work with local universities for permits; ensure water quality and safety testing

Q4: October – December

New Caledonia – Karst Highlands

  • Season: Dry season ends Oct; transition period good for access before cyclone season
  • Focus: Blue holes and sea-level karst systems
  • Notes: Coordinate with local speleological society; short-range island logistics

Türkiye-Turkey – Taurus Mountains

  • Season: Autumn ideal (Sept–Nov) for stable weather in upland karst
  • Focus: Technical diving in alpine sinkholes and resurgences
  • Notes: Partner with Turkish cave rescue/caving orgs; permits needed for deep systems

Optional Flex Window (Year-Round)

Vanuatu – Espiritu Santo & Pentecost Islands

  • Best Time: May to October (dry season)
  • Focus: Dive submerged karst caves and blue holes
  • Notes: Base from Luganville; consider combining with reef cave surveys

item.title: Applying Cousteau's Approach to Modern Cave Exploration - ChatGPT
item.description:
Related: Exploration

Applying Cousteau’s Approach to Modern Cave Exploration

Jacques Cousteau’s success in popularizing oceanography can be attributed to several key factors:

  1. Television and Documentary Filmmaking: Cousteau’s groundbreaking documentary series The Undersea World of Jacques Cousteau introduced millions of viewers to the beauty and mystery of the ocean. By bringing underwater exploration into living rooms through the medium of TV, he captured the public’s imagination. His ability to communicate science in an accessible and captivating way, often combining stunning visuals with storytelling, made oceanography feel more relatable.

item.description:

Models

GPT-4o - Excels at everyday tasks: Omni model for real-time, multimodal reasoning in everyday workflows.

  • Brainstorming, summarizing, emails, and creative content.
  • Fully multimodal: supports almost all capabilities (GPTs, data analysis, search, image generation, canvas, advanced voice) and inputs (documents, images, CSV files, and audio).

Example Prompts

  • Summarize meeting notes into key action items.
  • Draft a follow-up email after a project kickoff.
  • Proof read my report.
  • Brainstorm a launch plan in real time—feel free to upload sketches or screenshots.

item.title: Cheat Sheet - Fabric
item.description:
Related:

Potential Issue: Is Fabric creating summaries for the adverts that play at the start of YouTube videos?!?!

Fabric - GitHub Page

Basics

Using Fabric: input | fabric options -sp pattern_name |save "File Name" Options

  • -s (Stream output),
  • -p / –pattern (Pattern to choose)
  • -c / –context (context file use)
  • -l / –list (List available patterns)
  • –listmodels, –model, –changedefaultmodel
  • –remoteollamaserver (IP of local AI server to use)

Modify API keys and save folder: nano ~/.config/fabric/.env Update: fabric -u / –update (Reverts default to gpt-4o)`
